en.summary: RuneScape: Dragonwilds is Jagex's open-world survival crafting spin-off set on Ashenfall, a previously unexplored continent of Gielinor where dragons have awoken. Built in Unreal Engine 5, it supports 1–4 player co-op and blends familiar RuneScape lore and skilling progression with a modern gather-craft-build survival loop, tasking players with mastering the land and uncovering ancient secrets in order to challenge the Dragon Queen.

guideSections.title: Anima Magic: Survival Crafting with a RuneScape Twist
guideSections.description: How Anima, a magical force drawn from RuneScape lore, lets players cast spells that speed up resource gathering (like summoning spectral axes to fell trees) and repair gear — softening the genre's usual grind.

guideSections.title: Skills, Crafting & Repair
guideSections.description: How the skill-leveling and crafting recipe system carries over classic RuneScape skilling identity, and how the repair system keeps buildings and gear from permanently degrading with use.
